verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents automations (triggers, plain-English AI filter scripts, auto-apply rules), so versioning them is a fair question for this product. The pack has no evidence of version history, change review, or rollback for those automations. Undo send reverts a sent message to a draft, which is an adjacent feature and does not apply to automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
